messages:
sasha: Heads up — kicking off a small sync about adding org-scoped telemetry views & a noisy-neighbor detector into the console. Need runtime hooks and an API shape for per-org rollups.

jia: +1. Do we have a concrete list of signals we need from runtime vs infra?

sasha: Runtime: per-org token count, request QPS, p50/p95/p99 latency, KV-cache hit rate, model-switch fallbacks. Infra: GPU util by pool, queue length, routing-retries, preemption events. Also need per-org cost attribution bucket.

marc: For cost attribution — we should emit two flavors: "billing_units" (token/embedding units) and "effective_cost_cents" so console can show a $ column without rehydrating pricing.

indra: How expensive is shipping per-org metrics at high cardinality? We have a lot of ephemeral orgs in staging. Sampling? aggregated windows?

taylor: We can emit per-org 1m aggregates and a sampled 10s stream for top-N noisy orgs. Agree on cardinality limits. Also add a route label in the metric so we can group by routing policy (cheap vs fast).

alyssa: UX ask from product: console needs a per-org view that defaults to a 24h summary, and a noisy-neighbor panel that shows top 10 offending orgs with the ability to open runtime traces. Also lightweight alert toggles.

sasha: Proposed metric names (RFC):
```
redwood.org.{org_id}.requests.count
redwood.org.{org_id}.requests.tokens
redwood.org.{org_id}.latency.p50
redwood.org.{org_id}.latency.p95
redwood.org.{org_id}.kv_cache.hit_rate
redwood.org.{org_id}.fallbacks.count
redwood.org.{org_id}.cost.effective_cents
redwood.org.{org_id}.route_label
```
Keep them simple so infra can shard and rollup by prefix.

jia: API shape suggestion for rollups: GET /api/orgs/{org_id}/telemetry?from=...&to=...&granularity=1m returns arrays of numeric series plus meta for sample rate. Also support /api/telemetry/top-noisy?window=1h&metric=tokens&type=org to get top hitters.

marc: +1 on endpoints. Add a header X-Telemetry-SampleRate for sampled streams so console knows how to scale.

indra: On detection logic: propose a score = zscore(tokens, window) * (1 + overflow_ratio) + route_penalty. We can tune thresholds per-customer SLA tier.

taylor: Implementation note: runtime will tag spans with org_id and routing_policy; router already knows route_label. We can emit a compact proto over UDP to the telemetry aggregator with keys: org_id, metric_id, value, route_label, ts. Aggregator will do rollups.

alyssa: For privacy, we need to ensure per-org telemetry in hosted mode is only visible to org admins + Redwood internal ops (with audit). For Dedicated/Private, customers control visibility. Add a flag in the API: "visible_to=tenant_admins,redwood_ops".

sasha: Good point. Also add a throttling/quota consideration: we should expose a per-org quota summary (committed qps, burst tokens, current throttle rate) and wire that into the noisy neighbor panel to explain enforcement actions.

marc: Quota UI will want historical throttle events. Emit event stream: redwood.org.{org_id}.quota.throttle_events with small payloads: {reason,policy_id,count,ts}.

jia: One more internal-api debate: do we expose raw org_id or hashed org token in public APIs? For cross-service correlation inside Redwood we need raw org_id, but in some logs we should use hashed to avoid leakage. Propose raw for internal-only endpoints, hashed for external dashboards.

indra: Agree. Telemetry aggregator should be able to accept both; require an "internal=true" flag for raw org id ingestion.

taylor: Action items: runtime -> add compact proto and route_label tag (owner: taylor, ETA: next sprint). aggregator -> support per-org 1m rollups, top-N API and hashed/raw toggle (owner: jia, ETA: 2 weeks). console -> add per-org view + noisy neighbor panel (owner: alyssa, ETA: design review in 5 days). product -> policy for visibility + thresholds (owner: sasha, ETA: next week).

marc: I'll start a short doc with sample queries for Grafana/console and cost examples.

kb-bot: Reminder: @channel please add feature flag KEY=org-telemetry-preview to the rollout checklist.

sasha: Thanks. If folks can drop any blockers here by EOD we can finalize the OpenRFC and sync with security/legal on the visibility model.

jia: One blocker: need estimates on cardinality + storage cost from infra — tagging infra for numbers.

indra: I'll run a quick simulation on staging traces to estimate top-N sampling error and storage. Will share numbers tomorrow.

alyssa: Design will include an explainer tooltip about sampling and cost.

sasha: Great. We'll use this thread as the single source for initial decisions. Ping me if you want to be on the RFC review. :thumbsup:
